# Collectron: Biv Bev

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 5, 2024
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d9408aca9c6140fd82ce2c6482426eba~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

You'll never go thirsty with Biv Bev here to serve!

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Biv Bev Collectron Station__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7ec5a33f3293422cae286bcd548e6a13~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_29f085a5db734377907c25ce5e26e4e0~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Beer

- Blackwater Brew
- Empty Beer Bottle
- New River Red Ale
- Oak Holler Lager
- Old Possum
- Pickaxe Pilsner

Liquor

- Bourbon
- Empty Bourbon Bottle
- Empty Rum Bottle
- Empty Vodka Bottle
- Empty Whiskey Bottle
- Empty Wine Bottle
- Rum
- Vodka
- Whiskey
- Wine

Materials

- Boiled Water
- Brahmin Milk
- Corn
- Lemonade
- Mutfruit
- Razorgrain
- Snaptail Reed
- Sugar
- Wood Scraps

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

All other Collectrons.

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

10 pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - Biv Bev Collectron Station - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 Minutes and 12 Seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

#### **Flamingo Units**

5 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.
